comment: Role table for LowPolyAssetPack_Free: every mesh uses one material, MasterMaterial, a 32 x 32 flat-colour palette (TextureMap/MasterMaterial1px.png). A triangle's role comes from the palette cell its UVs sit in: "col,row" with row counted from the TOP of the image. Curated by hand, one line per cell a shipped model uses; the bake fails on a cell not listed here or in the entry's own `roles.cells`. `bake.mts --swatches <id>` prints each cell's mean colour for the human; nothing from the palette ships (its colours become role names, and the role's colour comes from the house at runtime or from a fixed literal in assets/props/model-kit.ts).
